comment: Upstream notice files that cargo-about 0.9.2 does not emit, because it only emits texts for licence ids in the resolved expression. Copied into SUPPLEMENT/ by rust_notices_check.py only for crates in the shipped graph, after a sha256 check. 'package' paths are relative to the crate's package directory from cargo metadata; 'committed' paths are relative to this recipe directory.

entries.reason: Compiled files carry Unicode terms (convert_UTF, every OS) and, on macOS only, APSL-2.0 and 4-clause UC BSD (breakpad_nlist_64.cc). The crate declares only BSD-3-Clause.
Notices for ported code (CC-BY-3.0 matching.go, BSD-3-Clause Go Authors and others). The crate declares MIT OR Apache-2.0, so these texts are dropped.

entries.source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/madsmtm/objc2/8852b424193ca41602281b3d7540d7c8ed51e49a/LICENSE.md (byte-identical at the .cargo_vcs_info.json commits of all four crates)
entries.reason: MIT declared, no MIT text with a holder exists upstream; LICENSE.md is the project's own licensing statement, including its Apple SDK note. macOS only.
MIT declared, no licence file in the package.

canonical_fallback_allowed.reason: Declares BSD-3-Clause but packages the Apache-2.0 text (same bytes as nalgebra 0.34.2's LICENSE, which is emitted). Release decision G6.
